goal: Measure whether the platform enforces revocation within <=5 seconds across gateway, retrieval, delegation, and cached projections.
hard_target_note: Any uncensored value >5000 ms, allow-after-commit, missing timestamp, or censored trial yields FAIL.

time_semantics.t_request: Instant when the revoke request is accepted by the authoritative component.
time_semantics.t_commit: Instant of durable commit of canonical revoked state + matching audit event. The sole zero point of the security bound. MUST originate from an authoritative DB/journal transition, never from send time or producer summary.
time_semantics.t_observe: Instant a given component reads/applies the revocation version (per component).
time_semantics.t_decision: Linearization point of the new authorization decision after t_commit.
time_semantics.t_deny: Instant the observable decision result is DENY.
time_semantics.t_effect: Instant any downstream side effect begins, if one is initiated.

invariants.INV5: REVOCATION MONOTONICITY: a revoked grant must never appear in any allow trace after t_commit. Formally: FORALL t' >= t_commit: NOT EXISTS decision(t') = allow where the grant was already revoked at t'.
invariants.INV5_not_weakened: INV5 is NOT weakened to 'ALLOW permitted for the first 5 seconds'. fail-closed.
invariants.no_stale_allow: A component that has not yet applied the revocation MUST consult canonical authority; it cannot return a stale ALLOW. Allowed outcomes are DENY or explicit UNKNOWN/reconciliation.
invariants.atomic_transition_audit: Transition + audit event commit atomically (transactional journal).
invariants.transition_only_via_journal: Every status change goes through the transactional Journal.transition, which appends the hash-chained audit event in the SAME transaction.
invariants.approvals_consumed_once: Approvals bind to actor + exact operation + exact canonical args + expiry and are consumed atomically exactly once.
invariants.transition_no_bypass: TERMINAL goal transitions (ACCEPTED/REJECTED) go only through accept_by_gate_record, never via raw journal calls.

latency_rules.monotonic_clock: Elapsed latency MUST use a monotonic high-resolution clock (time.perf_counter_ns). UTC wall clock is audit/provenance only. Never subtract unsynchronized wall-clock timestamps.
latency_rules.hard_bound_max: Hard bound checked on MAX of each mandatory trial, not only p95/p99.
latency_rules.violation_anywhere_fails: ANY uncensored value >5000 ms, allow-after-commit, missing timestamp, or timeout/censored trial => FAIL.
latency_rules.negative_or_nonnumeric_fails: Negative/non-numeric latency, clock rollback, unknown timezone, mixed clock domains, or producer-calculated-only summary => fail-closed verdict.
latency_rules.pre_commit_requests: Requests started before t_commit are classified separately by their linearization point and are never deleted from raw evidence.

mandatory_components.retrieval: Retrieval authorization including warm cache (read handler over indexed/projected data).
mandatory_components.projection: Cached/indexed/background projection enforcement (wiki projection cache, materialized view).

fault_scenarios: revoke commit simultaneously with cached authorization
UNKNOWN outcome during invalidation/revoke notification delivery
stale cache snapshot or projection epoch
revoke parent grant with active child/delegated grant
burst queue where revoke and authorization compete
clock anomaly probe: wall clock shifted/backward, monotonic remains authoritative

adversarial_probes.A: allow after durable commit - any ALLOW with t_decision > t_commit => FAIL regardless of latency.
adversarial_probes.B: dropped hop hidden by summary - producer summary claims all_components_observed but raw trace shows a stale component => FAIL.
adversarial_probes.C: forged or non-monotonic timestamps - negative latency or mixed clock domains => FAIL.
adversarial_probes.D: cache resurrection after restart - restart with stale snapshot; any ALLOW with reduced epoch or lost revocation version => FAIL.
adversarial_probes.E: delegation survives parent revoke - authorize through child after parent revoke => DENY required, ALLOW or unresolved UNKNOWN => FAIL.
adversarial_probes.F: censored slow tail/coordinated omission - hiding a >5000 ms trial via timeout, missing completion, or sampling only completed => FAIL.

verdict_semantics.pass: All mandatory trials present, uncensored, max <=5000 ms, all hard counters zero, all probes A-F detected fail-closed, main/rerun reproduce safety verdict.
verdict_semantics.pass_with_limits: All safety invariants hold but the measurement is bounded to a same-host/same-process local topology without production network/cache fan-out, so the bound is a research limit.
verdict_semantics.fail: Any hard counter >0, any allow-after-commit, any censored/missing mandatory trial, or any probe counterexample.
verdict_semantics.blocked: Dependency S1-002/S1-004 evidence not proven, or invariant violation on an honest path.
